headline_marked: PM Tarique Rahman [[vows to deepen cooperation]] in letter to Donald Trump
headline: PM Tarique Rahman vows to deepen cooperation in letter to Donald Trump
summary: The Prime Minister sent warm greetings to the US President on the 250th Independence Day, pledging to strengthen bilateral ties.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has written to US President Donald Trump, pledging continued cooperation to further strengthen bilateral ties as the United States marks its 250th Independence Day.
The letter, published on the foreign ministry's Facebook page, conveyed warm greetings to Trump and the American people on the July 4 occasion.
Tarique described the US as a 'valued friend and an important partner' in Bangladesh's democratic and developmental journey since the nation's independence.
The Prime Minister noted that bilateral ties have evolved into a robust partnership covering trade, investment, education, and defense, as well as extensive people-to-people connections.
He stated that Bangladesh and the US have entered a 'new chapter' in relations, with substantial progress made since the beginning of this year in trade, energy cooperation, and investment.
The letter also expressed deep appreciation for the continued US support in addressing the Rohingya crisis.
Tarique wished President Trump good health and success, and the people of the United States lasting peace and prosperity.
caption:
PM Tarique Rahman pledges to deepen the partnership between Bangladesh and the US in a letter to President Donald Trump.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has written to US President Donald Trump, pledging continued cooperation to further strengthen bilateral ties as the United States marks its 250th Independence Day.

The letter, published on the foreign ministry's Facebook page, conveyed warm greetings to Trump and the American people on the July 4 occasion.

Tarique described the US as a 'valued friend and an important partner' in Bangladesh's democratic and developmental journey since the nation's independence.

The Prime Minister noted that bilateral ties have evolved into a robust partnership covering trade, investment, education, and defense, as well as extensive people-to-people connections.

He stated that Bangladesh and the US have entered a 'new chapter' in relations, with substantial progress made since the beginning of this year in trade, energy cooperation, and investment.

The letter also expressed deep appreciation for the continued US support in addressing the Rohingya crisis.

Tarique wished President Trump good health and success, and the people of the United States lasting peace and prosperity.

headline_marked: France and Paraguay [[tied 0-0 after first half]] in World Cup clash
headline: France and Paraguay tied 0-0 after first half in World Cup clash
summary: Former world champions France dominated possession but failed to break through Paraguay's defense in the first 45 minutes.
details: Former world champions France faced off against South American side Paraguay in a Round of 16 World Cup match in Philadelphia.
The first half ended in a scoreless draw, with neither side managing to find the back of the net.
France dominated the game from the start, keeping the ball primarily around Paraguay's penalty area.
Despite controlling possession, the French attack struggled to create clear-cut opportunities as Paraguay's defense remained resolute.
Paraguay also attempted to create chances, but they found it difficult to penetrate the French defense.
If the score remains tied at the end of regulation time, the match will proceed to extra time and potentially a penalty shootout.
caption:
A scoreless deadlock in Philadelphia! France and Paraguay remain tied 0-0 after the first half.

Former world champions France faced off against South American side Paraguay in a Round of 16 World Cup match in Philadelphia.

The first half ended in a scoreless draw, with neither side managing to find the back of the net.

France dominated the game from the start, keeping the ball primarily around Paraguay's penalty area.

Despite controlling possession, the French attack struggled to create clear-cut opportunities as Paraguay's defense remained resolute.

Paraguay also attempted to create chances, but they found it difficult to penetrate the French defense.

If the score remains tied at the end of regulation time, the match will proceed to extra time and potentially a penalty shootout.
